leadText:
The Science Speed team (Japanese: サイエンススピード Science Speed) are characters of the day who appeared in Mounting an Electrifying Charge!.

They are a group of s whom entered the Charjabug race with a . They raced against , , and who had entered with Sophocles's Charjabug and , who disguised as a Charjabug. During the race, they managed to keep up with the Red Comet team, the Sophocles Lab team, and the Electric Princess team. During the second section of the race, however, their Charjabug got stuck in a sand pit and was not able to move any further. With this, the Science Speed team was eliminated from the race.
